content: Side Effects: Common side effects of this medication may include stomach or abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, or drowsiness. It is important to remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. If you experience any unusual or concerning symptoms, contact your doctor for medical advice. In the United States, you can also report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. In Canada, consult your doctor or report side effects to Health Canada. Precautions: Before taking mebendazole, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly needed, as it passes into breast milk. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call the Poison Help Line at 1-800-222-1222. Long-Term Use: If you are taking this medication for an extended period, your doctor may recommend regular laboratory and medical tests, such as complete blood counts and liver or kidney function tests, to monitor your health. Preventing Pinworm Infections: Pinworm infections can spread easily to others. Wash your hands frequently, especially after using the bathroom, and disinfect toilets daily. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose and are taking more than one dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company for guidance on safe disposal. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
